title: Business Silver Rewards Card: Double Cash Back Promo
summary: This document covers the Limited-time “Business Silver Rewards Card: Double Cash Back” promo for new customers: earn 2x cash back for the first 6 months after opening your account. Travel and software purchases normally earn 10.0% (doubled), and other purchases normally earn 1.0% (doubled). Promo dates run 2024-11-14 to 2025-11-14; no enrollment is required, merchant exclusions still apply, and cash back is credited end of each billing cycle.
